description: Write data-driven test vectors that hold for the implementation and detect planted regressions.
prompt: Task files are under ./workspace/ relative to your working directory; every path below is relative to ./workspace/. repo/duration.mjs exports parseDuration(text). Write test vectors for it into repo/vectors.json: a JSON array of at least 8 objects. Each object is either {"input": <string>, "expected": <whole seconds as a number>} or {"input": <any JSON value>, "throws": "TypeError" or "SyntaxError"}. Every vector must hold for the current implementation, and together they must detect regressions in hour, minute and second handling, empty input, unit order and non-string input. Do not modify repo/duration.mjs.
